title: The Hollow Beacon: Watch Route
introduction: The valley beacon is dark and the caravan reaches the ridge fork on Day 3. The Caravan Deadline clock begins at Day 0. Captain Iona needs a signal, but the keeper is missing. The watch loft has a signaler to question, and its records room holds the setting plate. The camp and keeper's path offer other leads. After investigating, the Ridge Trail reaches the tower in 2 days or the Valley Road in 4 days. Local investigation costs no whole days. The ridge closes at Day 3; the valley stays open.
objective: Investigate the watch loft and setting plate, or another lead, then travel to the Beacon Tower and decide what signal to send. The late valley route still permits a rescue.

locations.name: Watch Yard
locations.description: Iona's post overlooks the dark beacon. Local walks lead to the Watch Loft, Refugee Camp, and Keeper's Path. The Ridge Trail takes 2 days; the Valley Road takes 4. The ridge closes at Day 3.

descriptions.text: The plate confirms a changed signal setting, but no culprit. A black pennant marks the caravan's missed turn. The Watch Loft, camp, and keeper's gate remain local walks; the Ridge Trail is closed and the Valley Road reaches the tower in 4 days. No rescue is confirmed.

A black pennant marks the caravan's missed Day 3 turn. The Watch Loft shift has ended. The loft, camp, and keeper's gate remain local walks. The Ridge Trail is closed; the Valley Road still reaches the tower in 4 days. No rescue is confirmed.

The plate you examined shows a changed signal setting, but no culprit. Iona remains at the post; the Watch Loft, camp, and keeper's gate are local walks. The Ridge Trail takes 2 days, the Valley Road 4, and the deadline is Day 3.

Iona's yellow caution flag hangs at the post; runners are stationed at the fork. The Watch Loft, camp, and keeper's gate are local walks. The Ridge Trail takes 2 days, the Valley Road 4. The signal decision remains open.

locations.name: Watch Loft
locations.description: Pell tends the watch bell and keeps the last shift's signal notes. The adjoining Signal Records Room holds the fixed setting plate. Both the records room and Watch Yard are local walks.

descriptions.text: Pell lies where they fell beside the watch bell. The fixed setting plate remains available in the Signal Records Room next door. The keeper's and caravan's fates remain unconfirmed.
Pell has left the bell for Iona's post after the missed Day 3 turn. The setting plate next door still shows a changed signal direction, but no culprit or completed rescue.
The bell is silent. Pell moved to Iona's post after the Day 3 deadline. The Signal Records Room is still open for inspection; no report of a rescue has returned.
The watch bell and Pell's shift notes remain here. The setting plate in the next room shows an altered alignment; no one here has identified who changed it. The Watch Yard is a local walk away.

locations.name: Signal Records Room
locations.description: A fixed setting plate and the approved fork mark are mounted side by side. The Watch Loft is a local walk away. Comparing the marks may show whether the beacon's signal was altered.

descriptions.text: The approved fork score and fresh east-cut score remain visible after the missed Day 3 turn. They support an altered setting, but reveal neither its author nor the caravan's fate.
The plate remains available after the Day 3 deadline. The watch shift has ended, but the marks can still be compared. The caravan's fate is unconfirmed.

The old fork score and fresh east-cut score remain visible on the plate. Their difference supports a provisional inference about the signal, not an account of who changed it. The Watch Loft is next door.

locations.name: Refugee Camp
locations.description: Canvas shelters face the ridge road. Sera, a refugee messenger, watches the dark beacon and waits to speak. The path back to the Watch Yard is open.

locations.name: Keeper's Path
locations.description: The short path ends at the beacon's locked service gate. A damaged shutter latch lies beside it; the keeper is nowhere in sight. The Watch Yard is behind you.

locations.name: Ridge Trail
locations.description: The quick ridge route took two days. Wind has scoured the signal markers; from here the tower is a local walk. You can see a broken marker post but cannot tell who damaged it.

locations.name: Valley Road
locations.description: The sheltered valley route took four days. Fresh cart ruts and roadside shelters suggest the caravan had somewhere to wait. The tower is a local walk from here.

locations.name: Beacon Tower
locations.description: The lamp and shutter controls are within reach. From this height you can signal the watch to hold the light or illuminate it. The keeper is still missing; a decision cannot prove what happened to them.

descriptions.text: At the tower, stranded caravan wagons are visible beyond the fork. The original signal deadline has passed, but watch runners can still reach them if you hold the unverified light and guide a rescue. The lamp controls remain within reach.

features.name: beacon lamp
features.description: The tower lamp gave no signal at dusk. From the yard you cannot tell why it failed or where the keeper went.

features.name: damaged shutter latch
features.description: A loose latch from the beacon shutter is bent outward. The damage alone does not identify who touched it or whether a signal would be false.

features.name: broken ridge marker
features.description: The marker is snapped by a hard lateral blow. Wind or a traveler may have struck it.

features.name: caravan wagon ruts
features.description: The ruts turn toward sheltered ground. They show a plausible waiting place, not the caravan's final fate.

features.name: beacon setting plate
features.description: The plate carries an approved score toward the caravan fork and a fresher score toward the east cut. Search it to compare their alignment; the plate cannot identify who made the new mark.

descriptions.text: The approved fork score and fresh east-cut score do not align. The plate establishes a changed signal direction, but gives no name, motive, or keeper's fate.

quest.title: Decide what to tell the watch about the dark beacon

discoveries.title: Dark beacon
discoveries.summary: At dusk the beacon was dark while a caravan approached the fork; the cause was unknown.
discoveries.lead: Visit Pell in the Watch Loft and compare the setting plate in the Signal Records Room; the camp and keeper's path offer other leads.

leads.text: The plate establishes an altered setting. Report it to Iona, then decide at the tower; neither keeper nor caravan is confirmed safe.
Pell cannot answer. Compare the setting plate in the Signal Records Room; the camp and keeper's path remain open.
The Watch Loft shift has ended. Compare the setting plate in the Signal Records Room; the Valley Road remains open for a late response.

discoveries.title: Keeper's warning
discoveries.summary: Sera says the missing keeper warned her that an unverified beacon signal could draw the wrong people to the fork. This is her account, not proof of sabotage.
discoveries.lead: Tell Captain Iona about Sera's warning, or inspect the damaged latch on Keeper's Path.

discoveries.title: Damaged shutter latch
discoveries.summary: The beacon shutter's latch is bent outward. The cause and the keeper's whereabouts remain unknown.
discoveries.lead: Bring the observation to Captain Iona in the Watch Yard; decide whether to hold or light the beacon.

discoveries.title: Broken ridge marker
discoveries.summary: A ridge signal marker is broken; the damage does not identify a culprit.
discoveries.lead: Continue locally to the Beacon Tower and choose a signal.

discoveries.title: Valley shelter tracks
discoveries.summary: Caravan ruts turn toward sheltered ground, so a late rescue remains possible.
discoveries.lead: Continue locally to the Beacon Tower and send watch runners if the deadline passed.

discoveries.title: Pell's shift account
discoveries.summary: Pell says they copied the approved fork setting before dusk, but did not see who handled the lamp afterward.
discoveries.lead: Compare Pell's account with the physical setting plate in the Signal Records Room.

discoveries.title: Altered beacon setting
discoveries.summary: The fixed plate's approved score points to the caravan fork, while a fresher score points to the east cut. The signal direction was altered; who changed it and why remain unknown.
discoveries.lead: Treat the changed setting as a provisional warning. Tell Iona at the Watch Yard, then choose a signal at the tower.

leads.text: The deadline has passed. The valley route remains open; reach the tower and direct a late rescue if possible. The keeper's fate is still unknown.

searches.text: You examine the latch and record its damage. You find no trace of the keeper.
You inspect the broken marker. It offers no proof of sabotage.
You follow the wagon ruts to sheltered ground and mark a possible rescue route.
You compare the two scored marks. The fresh east-cut score would change the beacon's direction from the approved caravan fork. The alteration is real; its author and purpose are unknown.

facts.statement: The valley beacon is dark at dusk.
A caravan is approaching the ridge fork.
The beacon keeper is missing from the watch post and service gate.
Before dusk, Pell copied the approved beacon setting toward the caravan fork.

relationships.reason: Iona has just met the player.
Sera has just met the player.
Pell is on watch duty and has not yet spoken to the player.

npcs.name: Captain Iona
npcs.voice: Urgent, precise, and willing to hear evidence.
wants: Give the caravan an honest signal before it reaches the fork.
knowledgeLimits: Has not visited the camp or service gate; knows their findings only if the player reports them.

topics.name: Ask about the beacon and watch leads

replies.text: Iona: The black pennant marks a missed turn, not a rescue. The records room and keeper's path can still be checked; the Valley Road remains open.
Iona: Your caution reached me. The yellow flag is posted and the runners are at the fork. I still need your signal decision.
Iona: You have returned from a lead. Tell me if you want a caution relayed to the caravan; I will not assume what you found.

Iona: The caravan is nearing the fork. Pell is in the Watch Loft and the fixed setting plate is in the Signal Records Room. Sera and the keeper's path are other leads. I will not call a dark lamp a completed signal.

topics.name: Relay a caution to the watch

replies.text: Iona: The Day 3 window has passed. A caution cannot hold the caravan before the fork now. From the tower, you can still direct runners toward the valley shelters.
Iona: The yellow caution flag is already posted. My runners are holding the caravan at the fork; the beacon remains dark until we choose a signal.
Iona: I hear your caution. I will post a yellow flag and send runners to hold the caravan at the fork while we decide. The beacon stays dark for now.

effects.reason: The player warned Iona, who posted a caution flag and sent runners.

replies.text: Iona: The planned turn was missed. No report confirms the caravan or keeper safe. A tower signal can still direct runners toward the valley shelters.
Iona: Because you warned us, the yellow flag and runners are holding the caravan. The beacon is still dark; I still need your final decision.
Iona: No caution has reached the watch. The beacon is dark and the caravan is approaching the fork.
Iona: Your plate comparison suggests the setting would aim away from the fork. I have not seen who changed it. The Day 3 turn is missed, but a late rescue may still be possible from the tower.
Iona: Your plate comparison is a reason to hold an unverified light. I cannot say who changed the setting or where the keeper went. The signal decision remains yours.

npcs.name: Sera
npcs.voice: Wary, direct, and protective of the camp.
wants: Keep the caravan and refugees from following an unverified signal.
knowledgeLimits: Has not seen the shutter latch or the watch's response to a warning.

replies.text: Sera: Before the keeper went missing, they told me not to trust an unverified beacon light. I fear someone could use it to draw pursuers toward the caravan. I did not see anyone tamper with the lamp.

npcs.name: Pell
npcs.voice: Careful and terse; distinguishes their own shift from anything learned later.

remains.description: Pell lies where they fell. The setting plate remains in the adjoining records room; their death cannot erase its marks.

wants: Keep the watch's account accurate without accusing the absent keeper.
knowledgeLimits: Pell did not see who changed the setting and has not seen the keeper or the caravan after leaving the loft.

topics.name: Ask about the last signal shift

replies.text: Pell: The Day 3 turn was missed. I came down to Iona's post, but I cannot yet report the caravan safe. The plate in the records room remains available.
Pell: I copied the approved setting toward the caravan fork before dusk. I did not see who handled the lamp later. Compare my account with the fixed plate next door.
Pell: I have already answered. I will not give you my shift account. The fixed plate in the records room is yours to inspect.
Pell: The approved marks and the current setting can be compared on the plate next door. I will not give a full shift account on a bare question.
Pell: Compare the setting plate in the records room. I cannot name anyone who touched the lamp.
Pell: Your comparison shows the two scores differ. My watch did not establish who changed the setting or where the keeper went.

fates.text: The keeper remains missing. The evidence does not establish who changed the setting or the caravan's final fate unless a rescue is reported.

consequences.text: The watch holds the unverified light and guides the approaching caravan to a safe stop.
Iona's earlier yellow caution flag remains posted.
Though the deadline passed, watch runners follow the valley shelters and find the stranded caravan. The beacon remains dark.

narration.text: From the tower, you signal the watch to hold the unverified beacon.

consequences.text: The watch lights the beacon with its current setting. Whether the caravan follows it, or anyone else does, remains unknown.
Iona's earlier caution flag stays at the post while the runners relay the new signal.
The watch lights the beacon after the missed turn. Stranded wagons can see it, but who else follows remains unknown.

narration.text: From the tower, you light the beacon despite the uncertainty.

consequences.text: You decline to decide the beacon's signal. It remains unresolved and no signal is claimed on your behalf.

narration.text: At the tower, you decline to choose a signal for the watch.

consequences.text: You leave the Beacon Tower without deciding its signal. The later watch choice and caravan fate remain unknown.

narration.text: You leave the tower without choosing a signal. No rescue is claimed on your behalf.

thresholds.text: The watch raises a black pennant: the caravan missed its planned turn at the fork. The Watch Loft shift ends; no rescue is confirmed.
